items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: the first time I seen Louis in a parade... And that's the first time I seen Louis in a parade. Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, a lot older, see. But no, he basically is not that old, see. Because the first time, it's like Louis, the first time I seen Louis in a parade when he was in that Holmes. But I didn't see him until he came to Chicago to John Oliver's band, see. And that's the first time I seen Louis in a parade. Yeah.
I was wondering about if you ever did hear any brass band up in the country like your father's I was too young. Even in late years, if you went up for a visit.
